_doc: OT keymgr. Single TL target; kmac_data_o/i is app channel 0 (KMAC mode) toward the generated kmac; rom_digest_i comes from rom_ctrl's keymgr_data_o (generated-to-generated). Narrow ties here: lc_keymgr_en On(5), masking off (kmac translated with EnMasking=0), EDN like kmac's, all OTP/flash valid bits high. The WIDE seed/key/device-id/div constants (128..256-bit) exceed the tie width and are injected by the host harness / machine bridge instead.
